name: nginx.http2_restore
description: Turn HTTP/2 back on where nginx.http2_off turned it off, once nginx is fixed: put back exactly the lines each earlier nginx.http2_off changed (newest first), then nginx -t and a reload. It refuses, changing nothing, if any of those lines has changed since. If nginx -t or the reload fails, every file is put back as it was. Does nothing when there's no change to put back. The dry run (and the nginx_http2 state tool) lists what it would put back.
health_check: nginx -t and the reload pass; otherwise every file is put back.
